## Purpose

Describe the change. For a larger change, link the issue where it was agreed.

## Test Plan

List the commands and scenarios used to check the change.

## Test Result

Summarize the results and any checks that could not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] This is a small fix, or a larger change agreed in a linked issue
      ([what is accepted](https://github.com/logprobz/chopinfer/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md#what-is-accepted)).
- [ ] Explain the purpose and relevant behavior changes.
- [ ] Report the checks you ran (`bash ci/quick.sh`, and `bash ci/cpu.sh`
      when its prerequisites are in place).
- [ ] Update documentation if the change needs it.
